name: NCAA D-I Mountain Regional Cross Country Championships
headline: NCAA D-I Mountain Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: The toughest region in the country. Men: No. 1 New Mexico, No. 2 Colorado, No. 6 BYU and No. 20 Northern Arizona. Women: No. 1 BYU, No. 6 Northern Arizona, No. 7 New Mexico, No. 9 Colorado and No. 16 Utah. The top two teams and the top four individuals not on those teams qualify automatically for the NCAA Championships on Nov. 21. · Women 6K 11:00 a.m. MT · Men 10K 12:00 p.m. MT
